name: Securities Modification
definition: Modification of the reference data of a security or of the organisation that issued it.

ChangeType.name: Change Type
ChangeType.definition: Type of changes affecting the security form.

NumberOfSharesIssued.name: Number Of Shares Issued
NumberOfSharesIssued.definition: The number of shares the issuer is creating as part of the event

LastTradingDate.name: Last Trading Date
LastTradingDate.definition: Date/time at which the securities to be reorganised will cease to be tradeable.

NewOrganisationInformation.name: New Organisation Information
NewOrganisationInformation.definition: New name of a company following a name change.

RelatedCorporateEvent.name: Related Corporate Event
RelatedCorporateEvent.definition: Specifies the parameters of the event related to the modification of the securities.

NewSecurityReferenceData.name: New Security Reference Data
NewSecurityReferenceData.definition: Specifies the updated information of the new security.
